answer: One lever: epoch-seeded honeypot panels. The protocol salts sparse, tundra-thin grading panels with decoy answers whose correct score is pre-committed to the epoch seed. An operator hiding many masks behind a single inference pipeline grades every honeypot identically, in a correlated latency burst that peaks at the same zenith, exposing the shared mind. Masks that clump like one reef get their stake slashed. To evade, an attacker must run truly independent models with decorrelated timing per identity, so cost scales linearly with every fake, dissolving the economy of sybils.
